title: Part Five: The Ideology in Government

sections.brief: Begin in power 1977–1982: 'Judea and Samaria' and 'not an occupied country'; 'many Elon Morehs'; Drobles/Sharon plans and settler numbers (link wb4); the January 1978 message to Carter; the 28 Dec 1977 Self-Rule Plan (sovereignty claimed, 'left open'); Camp David; Elon Moreh ruling; Jerusalem Law 1980; Golan Heights Law 1981 and UNSC 497 (brief, link gi8); Sinai returned 1982. Figure: time

The 1977 Likud platform verified (JVL) and read whole: right, sovereignty 'between the Sea and the Jordan', eastern limit at the river; the 'still says' tense not verifiable; Central Committee votes of 12 May 2002 and 31 Dec 2017; leaders in office against party texts (Begin, Sharon 2005, Netanyahu Bar-Ilan 2009). Figure: compare

Nation-State Law 2018 (62–55; clause 7 settlement as national value, territorially undefined; Adalah's reading vs the state's in court; HCJ 5555/18 upheld 10–1, Karra dissent); the 37th government's guidelines of 28 Dec 2022 (exact wording vs the 'between the Mediterranean and the Jordan' paraphrase) and the Likud–Religious Zionism sovereignty clause with its timing caveat; Smotrich's Defense Ministry post.
